map.将猫狗年龄换算为人类年龄，含生命阶段对照: Convert cat and dog ages into human years, with a life-stage comparison
map.📖 查看「宠物年龄换算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pet Age Converter user guide
map.宠物年龄换算：犬首年 ≈ 人 15 岁、第二年 ≈ 人 24 岁，此后每犬年 ≈: Pet age conversion: a dog’s first year ≈ 15 human years, the second year ≈ 24 human years, and each dog year after that ≈ 4 to 5 human years (lower for small dogs, higher for large dogs); a cat’s first year ≈ 15 human years, the second year ≈ 24, and each cat year after that ≈ 4 human years; the puppy or kitten, adult and senior stages are labelled accordingly.
map.领养/救助年龄判断：流浪犬猫常不知确切生日，用估算年龄换算人类岁数，帮助判断已进: Estimating age for adoption or rescue: stray dogs and cats often have no known birthday, so converting the estimated age into human years helps judge whether they have entered old age (for example a 6-year-old large dog is equivalent to over 45 human years), and adjust feeding and check-ups accordingly.
map.老年病筛查时机：犬猫老年期（犬 7 岁 / 猫 8 岁起）对应人类中老年，建议每: Timing senior-disease screening: the senior stage of dogs and cats (from 7 years in dogs, 8 in cats) corresponds to middle and old age in humans, so a check-up every six months is recommended; the converted result tells the owner intuitively that the pet is equivalent to a human of a certain age.
map.体型差异：大型/巨型犬老化更快，同是 5 岁，小型犬≈人类 36 岁、巨型犬≈4: Body-size differences: large and giant dogs age faster; at the same 5 years of age, a small dog ≈ 36 human years while a giant dog ≈ 45, so check-up and joint-care schedules differ.
map.算例：5 岁中型犬 / 5 岁猫: Worked example: a 5-year-old medium dog and a 5-year-old cat
map.为什么大小犬换算系数不同？: Why do large and small dogs use different conversion factors?
map.大型犬成熟更快、寿命更短，老年病（关节、心脏）出现更早，故体型越大「每年对应人类: Large dogs mature faster and live shorter lives, and senior diseases (joints, heart) appear earlier, so the bigger the body the more human years each year counts (small dog +4, medium +5, large +6, giant +7). This model is a general approximation and is not the same as precise physiological age.
map.年龄换算能直接用于用药/疫苗吗？: Can the age conversion be used directly for medication or vaccination?
map.不能。换算仅帮助理解衰老程度与养护重点；疫苗、驱虫、用药剂量须按体重、健康状况与: No. The conversion only helps you understand the degree of ageing and the care priorities; vaccination, deworming and drug doses must follow body weight, health status and your vet’s plan. This tool does not replace professional diagnosis and treatment.
